'''Bareesh Fenn'ak Torill''', also known as '''Bareesh the Hutt''' or simply '''Bareesh''', was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] of the [[Bareesh]] Clan which was a part of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. He was also the leader of the [[Kintan Kings]] before being overthrown by five brothers known as [[The Mountain]]. Afterwards, he assisted the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] with its operations on Nar Shaddaa.
